decision.label: ANSWER
decision.response: If your soil is well-drained, plant on flat beds. If your soil is heavy and poorly drained during the rains, plant on raised ridges.
decision.justification: The document states that on well-drained soils, rain-fed crops may be planted on flat beds, but on heavy soils which are poorly drained during the rains, it is advisable to plant on ridges.
